status.summary: One-shot health check: git, build, deploy, game, log

workspace-status.summary: Cross-repo status: mod, sidecar, desktop, server, and event store
details: Returns one JSON snapshot covering the selected mod repo plus the local sidecar repo, managed desktop state, server health, and event-store presence.
This is read-only and intended for mixed-repo development sessions.

validate.summary: Agent review gate: diff check, tests, build, and review status
warnings: Side effects: writes xmake build/test artifacts and may take significant time.
-CleanTree fails validation when the selected repo has uncommitted changes.
details: Runs review status, xmake configure, pure tests, target build, and git diff --check for the selected repo/build mode.
Use for explicit validation after code changes, not passive command discovery.

game-running.summary: Check if the game process is running

config.summary: Show settings TOML or runtime vars

hotkeys-check.summary: Explain active hotkey bindings, defaults, NONE disables, and surprising overlaps

build.summary: Build the mod with xmake for the selected repo/build mode
warnings: Side effects: can run xmake clean/configure/build and write build artifacts.
Branch selection can switch to a local branch, but AX refuses branch switches while the selected repo has dirty changes.
If the game is running, the deployed DLL may be locked later even when build succeeds.
details: Configures xmake and builds the selected mod target. When -Branch is supplied, AX selects that local branch before building.
Reports build, branch, game-running, and xmake output tail metadata as JSON.

deploy.summary: Build, copy, and verify the deployed DLL in one step
warnings: Side effects: writes build artifacts and replaces the deployed game DLL.
Branch selection can switch to a local branch, but AX refuses branch switches while the selected repo has dirty changes.
Do not run during passive inspection; use ax deploy-status or ax deploy --help instead.
details: Builds the selected target, copies the resulting DLL into the configured game directory, then verifies the deployed hash.
The command refuses to continue when prime.exe is running because the DLL may be locked.

cycle.summary: Deploy, wait for game restart, then verify boot and recent errors
warnings: Side effects: can stop the running STFC process, build the mod, copy the DLL into the game directory, and launch the game.
Branch selection can switch to a local branch, but AX refuses branch switches while the selected repo has dirty changes.
Do not run during passive inspection; use ax deploy-status, ax preflight, ax status, or ax cycle --help instead.
details: Runs the full local development loop: stop the game if it is running, build/deploy the selected DLL, launch prime.exe, wait for fresh native log activity, then return boot status and recent warnings/errors as JSON.
Use this only when you intentionally want AX to touch the installed game and deployed DLL.

mark.summary: Write an AX marker into the live debug recent-events ring and native log
warnings: Side effects: writes a marker entry into the live debug recent-events ring and native log.
Requires a running game with live debug enabled.
details: Sends a live debug mark request so later log/recent-events output has a visible investigation boundary.

live-state.summary: Probe named live runtime state surfaces without hand-writing debug-send requests

observe.summary: Bounded live observation: recent events plus filtered appended log lines
warnings: Side effects are normally read/wait only, but -Mark writes marker entries through live debug.
Requires a running game for recent-events data and waits for the requested duration unless stopped by a match.
details: Polls live recent-events and appended native log lines for a bounded observation window.
Useful for watching a specific repro while preserving filtered JSON output.

recent-events.summary: Read, follow, or clear the live debug recent-events recap
warnings: Side effects are mixed: normal reads are passive, -Clear mutates the in-game recent-events buffer, and -Follow waits.
Requires a running game with live debug enabled.
details: Reads recent live-debug events from the running mod and can filter, summarize, stream, or follow new events.

battle-log.summary: Decode captured battle probe JSONL journals and compare battle_log signatures

deploy-status.summary: Compare built and deployed DLL hashes

doctor.summary: Check Python, dump DB, paths, build outputs, and config files

log.summary: Unified native log entrypoint with slice/session/errors/boot modes
warnings: -Summary has no effect with -TextOnly because text mode prints lines directly.
Use -CaseSensitive only with the default tail view; session mode still rejects it.
Reads local game/mod logs. Treat output as potentially sensitive unless redaction is explicitly verified.
Read-only does not mean output-safe; do not auto-run without user approval.
details: By default this tails community_patch.log. Add -Session, -Errors, or -Boot to switch modes without remembering the narrower commands.
-Summary works in JSON mode for all log views and omits the returned line arrays while keeping counts and metadata.

log-watch.summary: Bounded real-time log follow with the same high-signal filters as log-query
warnings: Reads local game/mod logs. Treat output as potentially sensitive unless redaction is explicitly verified.
Read-only does not mean output-safe; do not auto-run without user approval.

sidecar-package.summary: Fetch the sidecar AX package: status, event-store counts, and scoped recent event summaries

sidecar-export.summary: Export AX live diagnostics as sidecar-compatible debug.event JSONL or POST /api/events
warnings: Side effects: writes JSONL unless -NoWrite is used, and -Post sends diagnostics over HTTP.
Live event capture requires a running game with live debug enabled and may wait for -DurationSec.
details: Collects selected logs and optional live recent-events into sidecar-compatible debug.event records.
By default it can write a local JSONL export; -NoWrite suppresses file output, and -Post sends events to a sidecar endpoint.

sidecar-roundtrip.summary: Post one tagged AX sidecar-export session, verify ingest through the live sidecar package, and optionally snapshot the hostile report
warnings: Side effects: writes debug events into the sidecar event store and performs authenticated POST requests to the local sidecar ingest endpoint.
The command fails fast when the sidecar server is not healthy; relaunch the managed sidecar desktop app or use the sidecar desktop-cycle tool instead of probing arbitrary ports.
Sync tokens are resolved from parameter, environment, or desktop settings and are never echoed in the JSON result.
details: Resolves the local sidecar URL and sync token from the active desktop setup, posts a no-write AX sidecar-export batch to /api/events, then polls the sidecar AX package until the tagged debug session is visible.
This verifies the mod-to-sidecar debug ingest loop end to end without launching another server or writing a local JSONL export.
The observed-hostile community report is attached as a read-only summary by default because it is a useful sidecar health artifact, but it is not expected to change from debug-only export traffic.

warnings: Reads local game/mod logs. Treat output as potentially sensitive unless redaction is explicitly verified.
Read-only does not mean output-safe; do not auto-run without user approval.

log-boot.summary: Last boot sequence with hook install results
warnings: Reads local game/mod logs. Treat output as potentially sensitive unless redaction is explicitly verified.
Read-only does not mean output-safe; do not auto-run without user approval.

log-session.summary: Post-boot log lines from the current session
warnings: Reads local game/mod logs. Treat output as potentially sensitive unless redaction is explicitly verified.
Read-only does not mean output-safe; do not auto-run without user approval.

preflight.summary: Pre-cycle check: status + boot + recent errors

postflight.summary: Post-cycle check: deploy + boot + recent errors

investigate.summary: Class investigation: dump info, hierarchy, offsets, and prime header preview

dump-status.summary: Show dump/index freshness against the installed game binaries

dump-refresh.summary: Regenerate dump.cs from the installed game and rebuild the SQLite index
warnings: Side effects: writes or replaces generated dump files and cache/index data.
-Clean removes known dump outputs before regeneration. This can be slow and depends on installed game files.
details: Runs Il2CppDumper against the installed game binaries, writes dump artifacts, and rebuilds the local dump SQLite index unless -SkipIndex is used.

dump-index.summary: Rebuild the SQLite dump index from dump.cs
warnings: Side effects: writes local cache/index data and may replace the existing dump database.
Use read-only dump search commands for passive inspection.
details: Builds or refreshes the local SQLite dump index from dump.cs, string literals, and script metadata.

dump-stats.summary: Summary stats for the dump index: counts, kinds, namespaces

dump-class.summary: Look up a class by name from the dump index

dump-hierarchy.summary: Walk a class inheritance chain from the dump index

dump-method.summary: Find methods by name (optionally scoped to a class)

dump-enum.summary: Look up an enum and optionally list its values

dump-offsets.summary: Show field offsets for a class

dump-fts.summary: FTS5 ranked search across classes, methods, and fields

dump-find.summary: Navigation-first dump search with curated next steps and short hit lists

dump-symbol.summary: Search compact precomputed class symbol cards

dump-pack.summary: Return one token-budgetable class context pack

dump-export.summary: Export embedding-ready JSONL from local dump indexes
warnings: Side effects: -Output writes a JSONL file and may produce a large artifact.
Reads local dump indexes only; it does not touch the running game.
details: Exports selected local dump-index content as JSONL suitable for embedding, review, or corpus transfer.
Without -Output the export is written to stdout; with -Output it writes the requested file.

pure-tests.summary: Build and run stfc-mod-tests with JSON output
warnings: Side effects: writes test build artifacts and executes the local test binary.
This is safe for validation but not passive inspection.
details: Builds the stfc-mod-tests target and runs it, returning JSON with build/run exit codes and output tails.

release-validate.summary: Run schema/docs drift checks, pure tests, stfc-community-mod build, and git diff --check
warnings: Side effects: writes build/test artifacts and may take significant time.
Use only when explicitly validating release readiness.
details: Runs the release validation path for the selected build mode: configure, pure tests, target build, and git diff --check.
